stories.title: Red River redemption: Oklahoma's last-second FG stuns No. 1 Texas
stories.summary: Oklahoma kicks a late field goal to hand No. 1 Texas its first loss of the season, 27-24 in the Red River rivalry.

stories.title: Sources: Cardinals finalizing deal to trade WR Harrison Jr.
stories.summary: The Cardinals are finalizing a deal to trade Marvin Harrison Jr., sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Indiana uses 'indomitable will' in comeback win over Nebraska
stories.summary: Nick Marsh scored a 44-yard touchdown on fourth down to give No. 7 Indiana its first lead in a 20-17 victory over Nebraska on Saturday.

stories.title: UCLA rides Knight's 2-TD day to take down Oregon, remain undefeated
stories.summary: UCLA overcame an injury to starting QB Nico Iamaleava and got two touchdowns from running back Wayne Knight in a 17-15 win over Oregon that improved the Bruins to 5-0.

stories.title: USWNT 'frustrated' but 'not deterred' by loss to world champs Spain
stories.summary: USWNT coach Emma Hayes lamented her team's lack of goal scoring in a 2-0 loss to Spain on Saturday, but saw signs of progress ahead of next year's World Cup.
